messages:
anya: Hey — noticing a weird regression after the NCCL bump to 2.25 in eu-central. Several inference jobs on A100 NVLink nodes started stuttering and then hang on allreduce.
devon: ugh, saw similar alerts. Which fleets/instance types?
sasha: eu-central-1, a cluster of 8xA100s (nvlink mesh). Latency spikes then full stall. One job got stuck at `step 345` with no kernel activity.
anya: sending logs: ```
[2026-03-18T07:02:11Z] ncclNetRecvTimeout
[2026-03-18T07:02:11Z] NCCL Allreduce start
[2026-03-18T07:02:13Z] GPU0 kernel: 0x0
[2026-03-18T07:05:30Z] watchdog: no progress, aborting
``` 
marco: any patterns on model sequence length or batch sizes? some collectives are fine.
anya: mostly 1024 tokens, batch 4. But smaller workloads also hit it when we route to the same node pool.
devon: Did the node kernel/driver also change with the NCCL bump? We upgraded CUDA 12.3 -> 12.4 on those hosts last night.
sasha: yes upgrade included driver 542.xx. Could be CUDA-driver-NCCL interaction.
oliver: infra-bot reported the rollout: "infra-bot: staged rollout of nccl 2.25 -> eu-central (70% nodes) completed @ 07:00 UTC". rollback not yet triggered.
anya: repro'd on canary: running a simple allreduce loop reproduces 2-3 minute stall, then either recovers or needs process restart.
marco: quick mitigation idea: force NCCL P2P disable or set NCCL_TOPO_DISABLE=1? Might change pathing.
devon: we tried `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` on a failed job and it progressed past the hang point. Perf degraded ~25% but stable.
sasha: can we patch rollout to set `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` as a node-level env until we debug? That would buy time.
oliver: note: disabling P2P has cost/throughput impact — affects SLA billing. ops wants approval.
anya: created a short spike analysis: `nvtop` showed long idle on GPU despite PCI traffic active. Kernel timestamps align w/ nccl retries.
marco: next steps: 1) pin canary to old nccl on a subset, 2) roll forward with P2P disabled, 3) collect per-req KV logs + `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` on failing runs.
devon: also check NVLINK firmware versions — nvlink fw mismatch has bitten us. I'll open a hw ticket.
sasha: I'm grabbing perf traces now. If we can't stabilize by 11:00 UTC, recommend rollback for eu-central full cluster.
infra-bot: Incident watcher: new regression tag added to thread "nccl-2.25-collective-stutter"; paging list notified.
oliver: I'll escalate to platform leads; cost impact estimate if we disable P2P on 40% of traffic: ~+18% GPU token cost.
anya: thanks — posting trace artifacts to the thread, will attach `strace`, `dmesg`, and NCCL logs. Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with temporary P2P disable.
devon: +1
sasha: +1
marco: +1
oliver: +1 (ops approved for 4 hours temporary env change)
